profile_text: Specializing in high-performance polymer tubes and tubing systems, this Düsseldorf-based manufacturer has experienced significant growth, with a 76.9% increase in employees since its baseline. The development and production of advanced polymer tubing solutions drive this company's success, catering to various industries that require high-quality, specialized tubing systems. With 46 employees as of 2024, its expanding workforce reflects the rising demand for its innovative products.
